examples.sentence: 他来自北京的一所大学。
examples.romanization: tā láizì Běijīng de yī suǒ dàxué。
examples.translation: He is from a university in Beijing.

title: S + (所) + V + 的 (what S V)
longExplanation: what S V. Pinyin: S + ( suǒ) + V + de

examples.sentence: 山水画(所)表现的是人与自然的关系。
examples.romanization: shānshuǐhuà( suǒ) biǎoxiàn de shì rén yǔ zìrán de guānxi。
examples.translation: What the landscape painting shows is the relationship between man and nature.

examples.sentence: 随着年龄的增大，女性的职场幸福感有所提高。
examples.romanization: suízhe niánlíng de zēngdà， nǚxìng de zhíchǎng xìngfú gǎn yǒusuǒ tígāo。
examples.translation: As [their] age increases, women’s happiness at work has increased.

title: 无所 V (have nothing to V)
longExplanation: have nothing to V. Pinyin: wú suǒ V

examples.sentence: 你要是坚持真理就可以无所畏惧。
examples.romanization: nǐ yàoshi jiānchí zhēnlǐ jiù kěyǐ wú suǒ wèijù。
examples.translation: If you stick to the truth, you've nothing to fear.

title: 与 N 相当 (equivalent to N)
longExplanation: equivalent to N. Pinyin: yǔ N xiāngdāng

examples.sentence: 开车打电话的人的反应速度与醉酒者相当。
examples.romanization: kāichē dǎdiànhuà de rén de fǎnyìng sùdù yǔ zuìjiǔ zhě xiāngdāng。
examples.translation: The reaction speed of the person who calls while driving is equivalent to a drunk.

title: 相当于 N (equivalent to N)
longExplanation: equivalent to N. Pinyin: xiāngdāngyú N

examples.sentence: 这种鸟一天所食的害虫相当于自己的体重。
examples.romanization: zhèzhǒng niǎo yī tiān suǒ shí de hàichóng xiāngdāngyú zìjǐ de tǐzhòng。
examples.translation: The pests that this bird eats a day are equivalent to its own weight.

examples.sentence: 菜的味道好极了，服务也周到，我相当满意。
examples.romanization: cài de wèidao hǎo jíle， fúwù yě zhōudào， wǒ xiāngdāng mǎnyì。
examples.translation: The dish is very delicious, the service is also thoughtful, I am quite satisfied.

examples.sentence: 相当一部分人会以收入多少作为幸福的标准。
examples.romanization: xiāngdāng yībùfèn rén huì yǐ shōurù duōshao zuòwéi xìngfú de biāozhǔn。
examples.translation: A considerable number of people will regard their income as a standard of happiness.

examples.sentence: 我大概数了一下，车上有32个学生。
examples.romanization: wǒ dàgài shǔ le yīxià， chē shàng yǒu32 gè xuésheng。
examples.translation: I roughly counted it, there are 32 students in the vehicle.

title: 数 (shǔ) (to be reckoned as)
longExplanation: to be reckoned as. Pinyin: shǔ (shǔ)

examples.sentence: 要说我们班跑得最快的，那就数李阳了。
examples.romanization: yàoshuō wǒmen bān pǎo dé zuì kuài de， nà jiù shǔ lǐ yáng le。
examples.translation: If we were to discuss who our class runs the fastest, then it’s no other than Li Yang.

examples.sentence: 这里夏季的雷阵雨一般可持续数小时或者更久的时间。
examples.romanization: zhèlǐ xiàjì de léizhènyǔ yībān kěchíxù shùxiǎoshí huòzhě gèng jiǔ de shíjiān。
examples.translation: The thunderstorms in summer here generally last for several hours or longer.

examples.sentence: 学校的领导、教师以及一些学生代表观看了演出。
examples.romanization: xuéxiào de lǐngdǎo、 jiàoshī yǐjí yīxiē xuésheng dàibiǎo guānkàn le yǎnchū。
examples.translation: School leaders, teachers, and some student representatives watched the show.

examples.sentence: 问题已经发展到了十分严重的程度。
examples.romanization: wèntí yǐjīng fāzhǎn dàoliǎo shífēn yánzhòng de chéngdù。
examples.translation: The problem has grown to a very serious degree.

examples.sentence: 连运动员都不满意，更何况看比赛的球迷呢？
examples.romanization: lián yùndòngyuán dōu bùmǎnyì， gèng hékuàng kàn bǐsài de qiúmí ne？
examples.translation: Even the athletes are not satisfied, let alone the fans watching the game?

title: 何必 (What for? Why do you have to…?)
shortExplanation: What for? Why do you have to…?
longExplanation: What for? Why do you have to…?. Pinyin: hébì

examples.sentence: 你何必亲自送一趟呢？叫个快递不就行了？
examples.romanization: nǐ hébì qīnzì sòng yī tàng ne？ jiào gè kuàidì bù jiù xíng le？
examples.translation: Why do you have to deliver it yourself? Calling a courier is not enough?
